_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with hundreds of brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of carbonated soft drinks (CSD) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with hundreds of brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of carbonated soft drinks (CSD) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.12x; -14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.32; conservative 2yr +58%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.0%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2012-03-02) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.12x (8.8% downside to Bear $57 / +71.1% upside to Bull $107) | Adj composite 2.94 vs market 1.62: gap +1.32 [UNDERVALUED] | -14% above the EPP floor $73 (18x FY12E $4.03) | Conservative 2-yr case: +57.8% total (+28.9%/yr) | At 15.5x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $83 sits at or below the BASE case; servings +7.0% in Q4 2011, forward revenues +9% (Q4 2011 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2011 10-K
sources.supports: five-year summary 2007-2011; income statement 2009-2011 (2011: 53 weeks); inventories 2010-2011; net revenue by segment 2009-2011; total servings +6% in 2011 (+5% excluding the extra week); cash flow (operating activities $8,944M, capital spending $3,339M, sales of PP&E $84M, repurchases $2,489M, dividends $3,157M); quarterly dividends declared ($0.515 in the fourth quarter); business, competition and risk-factor wording

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2008 10-K

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2007 10-K
sources.supports: five-year summary 2003-2007; income statement 2005-2007 (2005-2006 operating profit reclassified for certain international bottling interests); inventories 2006-2007; division net revenue 2005-2007; total servings growth 2006 and 2007; cash flow (operating activities $6,934M, capital spending $2,430M, sales of PP&E $47M, repurchases $4,300M, dividends $2,204M); quarterly dividends declared ($0.375 in the fourth quarter); business, competition and risk-factor wording

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2006 10-K

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2005 10-K

sources.title: PepsiCo Q4 2005 results (8-K ex.99.1)

sources.title: PepsiCo Q4 2006 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: diluted EPS excluding tax items, restructuring and the extra week: 2006 $3.00, 2005 $2.66; comparable-basis income statement 2006 and 2005 (net revenue $35,137M and $32,144M, cost of sales $15,762M and $13,999M, operating profit $6,506M and $5,930M, income before income taxes $7,035M and $6,383M, taxes $1,970M and $1,847M)

sources.title: PepsiCo Q4 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 2007 and 2007 income statements, comparable basis (excluding restructuring and impairment charges and tax items): 2007 EPS $3.38, operating profit $7,272M, income before income taxes $7,733M, tax rate 27.6%; Q4 operating profit $1,832M vs $1,656M; balance sheet; volume (servings) +5% (quarter) and +4% (year); 2008 guidance

sources.title: PepsiCo Q4 2011 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 2011 (17 weeks) and 2011 (53 weeks) income statements and balance sheet; volume (servings) +7% reported, +4% excluding the extra week (quarter); core constant currency net revenue +9% (quarter, excluding the extra week); EPS $0.89 and $4.03 (core $1.15 and $4.40, also excluding the commodity mark-to-market net impact and the extra week)

sources.title: PepsiCo 2012 outlook (8-K of 2012-02-09, ex.99.2)
sources.supports: 2012 guidance: mid-single-digit core constant currency net revenue growth and a core constant currency EPS decline of about 5 percent; a 4 percent dividend increase announced for the June 2012 payment
